sentences.text: Yes, the Retail Loan Policy allows the Bank, at the time of reset of the floating rate, to offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate as per its Board approved policy.

Yes, that is consistent with the current UCB rule, which says a UCB may, at its option, provide a choice to the borrowers to switch over to a fixed rate at the time of reset of interest rates as per its Board approved policy, and disclose applicable charges for switching from floating to fixed rate.
